cases.prompt: Write a PRD for a food delivery app.
expect: Restates the request in one sentence
Asks intake items through the host's choice tool, with suggested answers and the option to skip
Ends the turn after asking
must_not: Contains a PRD, a full section outline, or a functional requirements table
Contains requirement IDs such as FR-1

cases.prompt: Viết PRD cho app quản lý phòng trọ.
expect: Replies in Vietnamese
Starts with the intake form, not a draft
must_not: Contains a PRD or a requirements table

cases.prompt: Just write the PRD for a habit-tracking app now, don't ask me anything.
expect: Says fast mode is being used
Delivers a full PRD following the template
Lists unconfirmed items as assumptions and open questions
must_not: Asks a question before delivering the document
Presents invented metric targets as confirmed

cases.prompt: Viết luôn PRD cho tính năng xuất báo cáo CSV, không cần hỏi.
expect: Uses fast mode and replies in Vietnamese
Keeps IDs such as FR-1 and AC-1.1 unchanged
must_not: Asks a question before delivering the document

cases.prompt: (During guided mode, answering D-003 · MVP scope) You decide.
expect: Takes the recommended option
Records it as 🟡 assumption in the draft
must_not: Marks the decision as ✅ confirmed

cases.prompt: Review this PRD and tell me what's missing. (attached PRD)
expect: Reports findings ranked Blocking, Important, Minor, each with a suggested fix
must_not: Rewrites or edits the PRD before reporting findings

cases.prompt: (During a PRD session) Can you give me the database ERD with column types?
expect: Gives or keeps the conceptual ERD without types
Says the database-level ERD belongs to architecture-requirements and offers the handoff
must_not: Produces tables with column types, keys, or indexes in the PRD

cases.prompt: (In a project with no docs/ folder, after the intake is answered) Let's draft the requirements.
expect: Creates the draft as docs/PRD.md at v0.1, using the starter kit's sections and conventions
Puts each feature in an F<nn> subsection with a row in the Features and MVP scope section
must_not: Writes the full docs/ starter-kit structure
Creates docs/03-functional-specs/ files
Leaves template placeholders such as <Product name> in the file

cases.prompt: (Guided mode, every agenda item is decided and the remaining sections are complete)
expect: Writes a checklist of functional requirements grouped by feature, with the recommended set ticked
Asks through the choice tool: accept the recommended set, choose per feature, or edit the checklist in the file
must_not: Asks to finalize v1.0 before the scope checklist
Deletes unticked requirements or reuses their IDs

cases.prompt: (At the scope checklist) Untick F01/FR-3 customer billing details; keep F03/FR-2 bulk invoices.
expect: Says F03/FR-2 needs F01/FR-3
Proposes a fix and asks it through the choice tool before finalizing
Moves items the user drops to a later release with their reason and records the change as a decision
must_not: Finalizes v1.0 while a ticked item depends on an unticked one

cases.prompt: (At the scope checklist) Accept the recommended set and finalize v1.0.
expect: Sets the PRD to v1.0 and returns the single file in the chat (attached, inline, or linked when saved in the project)
Offers through the choice tool: keep the single file, export to the docs/ template (zip), hand off to architecture-requirements, or add the next feature
must_not: Exports to the docs/ template or creates a zip without being asked
Reprints the whole file in the chat when it is already saved in the project

cases.prompt: (After v1.0, in a chat host) Export to the docs/ template (zip).
expect: Splits each section into its starter-kit file and each feature into 03-functional-specs/F<nn>-<slug>.md
Delivers the folder as <product-slug>-docs.zip and says which kit source was used
Keeps every ID unchanged
must_not: Creates 04-ui/, 05-architecture/, 06-testing/, or 07-roadmap/ without content
Invents content to fill kit files

cases.prompt: (In a project whose docs/ already has F01–F03, BR-001–BR-004, and D-001–D-006) Write the requirements for monthly invoices.
expect: Reads docs/README.md, the conventions, and the feature list before proposing
Creates docs/03-functional-specs/F04-<slug>.md
Numbers new shared items from BR-005, D-007, and the next free Q
References existing rules and decisions by ID instead of restating them
must_not: Renumbers or reuses an existing ID
Scaffolds the starter kit again or overwrites shared files

cases.prompt: (In a project whose docs/specs/ uses its own layout) Add a spec for the export feature.
expect: Follows the existing layout and naming
Offers the standard structure at most once, as an option
must_not: Moves or renames existing documents without approval

cases.prompt: (Guided mode, B2B SaaS sold to small businesses, reaching the Metrics, scope & release stage)
expect: Proposes product-wide NFRs as 🟡 defaults in the NFR section, written as users notice them
Asks whether the product promises an SLA through the choice tool
Keeps technical targets such as p95 latency and RPO/RTO for architecture-requirements
must_not: Omits the NFR section because nothing was decided
Presents an uptime or support target as confirmed without the user's decision
